title: System-wide config rule: accounts configure only which strategies/MLs are active; no per-symbol config; an ML's traded symbols are internal to the ML, set by which per-symbol tests passed. Codify in the canonical docs and apply to every ML
note: OPERATOR 2026-11-04, verbatim. ~19:04Z: "the configuration doesn't specify what trades. It doesn't specify like what coins or what security trades. It just specifies which strategies, including which MLs, are active on that account. That's it." ~19:06Z: "It's not just for Alpaca. That's like a general rule across how all of the accounts are configured. There's no per symbol configuration. There's only per strategy configuration. Specific strategies trade one symbol usually, but the MLs trade whatever is whatever they're set to trade. They don't have their roster is internal to the ML, and it's based on what tests have passed versus which ones have not." ~19:08Z: "start the ML-UNIVERSE-RULE lane now" (dispatched 19:05Z, Opus, $20). Popups ~19:08Z: "Split (Recommended)", "Per-symbol passes (Recommended)", "Per-symbol tests (Recommended)"; ~19:18Z pass bar: "Shrunk >= 0, n >= 100 (Recommended)". Rule as recorded: the set is derived from a committed per-symbol pass record; an absent/indeterminate record keeps the current set. OPERATOR DECISION 2026-11-04 ~19:33Z (popup to Manager Session 2026-11-04a, verbatim): "Group-level (Recommended)". Meaning, as put to the operator: an ML trades the WHOLE population its registered pooled test passed on, net of each symbol's own costs, minus a cost/liquidity filter fixed before the run; per-symbol results are monitoring only and never add or remove a symbol. Supersedes the ~19:08Z "Per-symbol passes"/"Per-symbol tests" answers and the ~19:18Z "Shrunk >= 0, n >= 100" answer. Context, operator ~19:25Z verbatim excerpt: "Maybe it shouldn't be gated at a per symbol basis, but rather it should be kept more general ... I didn't mean to make the rules stricter than they had and the ML had been designed for." Consequence now: bybit_2/bybit_portfolio keep the 5 c692-06 perps until a24c-01 (pooled, Bybit-listed, each net of its own spread) passes; testing MLs on the demo floor trade their pending test's population (Tier-3 proposals). Canonical text lands with PR #22914 (held); resolver #22928.
